itinerary.title: Departure from Lahore & Welcome to Murree
schedule: 07:00 AM - Morning departure from Lahore via AC Coaster / Saloon Car (PKR 3,000).
01:00 PM - Arrival in Murree; welcome refreshments and orientation.
02:00 PM - Check-in at 3-Star Deluxe Hotel (PKR 5,000/night) and relaxation.
04:00 PM - Initial exploration: Mall Road stroll & shopping.
07:30 PM - Dinner featuring regional cuisine followed by an evening walk.

itinerary.title: Full Day Discovery: Patriata (New Murree) Chairlift & Cable Car ride
schedule: 09:30 AM - Morning excursion: Patriata (New Murree) Chairlift & Cable Car ride.
01:00 PM - Traditional local lunch and photography session.
02:30 PM - Afternoon adventure: Kashmir Point scenic viewpoint.
06:30 PM - Sunset observation from vantage point.

itinerary.title: Farewell Murree & Return to Lahore
schedule: 08:00 AM - Breakfast and check-out from hotel.
09:30 AM - Morning visit: Pindi Point pine walk & souvenir shopping.
12:00 PM - Farewell lunch with scenic panorama.
01:30 PM - Departure on return journey towards Lahore.
08:30 PM - Expected safe arrival in Lahore.
itinerary.night_stay: Trip concluded - Return to home city
